title: Honua metadata and catalog endpoint inventory

entries.title: OGC API Records public catalog
entries.audience: Public catalog clients, OGC clients, and first-party SDK catalog discovery.
entries.authPosture: Public route with service/layer/record access policy; exact anonymous or token posture is finalized by honua-io/honua-server#952.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaOgcRecordsClient in honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146

entries.responseKind: OGC API Records JSON; raw JSON access required in every SDK.
entries.paginationFiltering: Planned OGC Records paging and filters. Server #952 must pin limit, offset/cursor, bbox, datetime, text, CQL/filter, sort, and collection semantics before SDK implementation.
entries.testExpectation: Server #952 adds route and contract tests; SDK issues add discovery, search, record detail, paging/filter, auth, error, and raw-payload tests.

entries.title: GeoServices REST service directory
entries.audience: ArcGIS-compatible clients and SDK service discovery.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy; deployments may require API key or bearer auth for protected services.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaCatalogClient service discovery plus GeoServices client factories

entries.responseKind: GeoServices-compatible JSON service directory.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging. Supports f=json or f=pjson.
entries.testExpectation: GeoServices catalog endpoint tests and SDK service-list tests verify visible service filtering and FeatureServer/MapServer/ImageServer entries.

entries.title: Admin service catalog and settings
entries.audience: Operators, admin SDKs, and catalog clients that need control-plane service metadata.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaCatalogClient.ListServicesAsync and HonuaAdminClient service settings

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelope with service summaries or settings.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging. Service settings are addressed by service name.
entries.testExpectation: Admin service settings tests and SDK admin catalog tests cover list/detail and protocol metadata.

entries.title: Admin connection table and published layer inventory
entries.audience: Operators and SDK publishing workflows that need table and layer inventory.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient table discovery and layer publishing inventory

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelope with table or published layer summaries.
entries.paginationFiltering: No SDK-visible paging in the current contract. Layer list accepts serviceName where supported by the server endpoint.
entries.testExpectation: Layer publishing and table discovery tests cover response contracts; SDKs keep this separate from public catalog reads.

entries.title: Admin metadata resources, groups, and source descriptors
entries.audience: Operators and SDKs reading Honua metadata resources such as Group and SourceDescriptor.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient metadata resources and IHonuaCatalogClient groups/source descriptors

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelope with honua.io metadata resource documents and ETags on detail reads.
entries.paginationFiltering: List filters by kind and namespace. No paging in the current contract.
entries.testExpectation: Metadata resource tests cover filters, URL encoding, ETags, 404, 412, and 428 behavior; SDK parity tests cover Group and SourceDescriptor reads.

entries.title: Admin metadata manifest export and apply
entries.audience: Operators, GitOps automation, and SDKs that export or validate metadata manifests.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient manifest export/apply

entries.responseKind: Admin ApiResponse envelope with metadata manifest or manifest apply result.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging. Apply supports dry-run, prune, and approval semantics where enabled by capabilities.
entries.testExpectation: Manifest tests cover export, apply, dry-run, prune, and SDK compatibility feature flags.

entries.title: Admin layer style metadata
entries.audience: Operators and SDKs that inspect or move style metadata as data.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient layer style methods

entries.responseKind: Admin style JSON, SLD XML export, or style suggestion response.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging. Addressed by layer id; SLD import/export are format-specific.
entries.testExpectation: Style endpoint tests cover MapLibre JSON, SLD import/export diagnostics, and stable unsupported-style codes.

entries.title: SDK scene metadata and endpoint resolution
entries.audience: SDK clients that need hosted scene metadata without admin registration rights.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by scene access policy; protected scenes can require signed access envelopes.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaSceneClient list/get/resolve
sdkTargets.javascript: Scene metadata client methods where present
sdkTargets.python: Scene metadata client methods where present or deferred in the SDK matrix

entries.responseKind: SDK-compatible scene metadata JSON and render-ready endpoint resolution.
entries.paginationFiltering: No paging in the current contract. List returns visible scenes.
entries.testExpectation: Scene discovery tests and SDK protocol integration tests cover list, detail, resolve, and protected-scene access behavior.

entries.title: Admin scene dataset registry
entries.audience: Operators managing registered scene datasets.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient scene dataset registry methods where exposed
sdkTargets.javascript: Admin scene dataset client methods where exposed
sdkTargets.python: Admin scene dataset client methods where exposed

entries.responseKind: Admin scene dataset summary/detail/resolve JSON.
entries.paginationFiltering: List supports includeInactive. No paging in the current contract.
entries.testExpectation: Scene dataset registry tests cover list/detail/resolve and SDKs document unsupported rows if a language does not expose admin scene registry methods.

entries.title: GeoServices FeatureServer metadata
entries.audience: ArcGIS-compatible clients and SDK feature query/edit adapters.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by service/layer access policy; protected layers may require API key or bearer auth.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaFeatureServerClient service/layer metadata and descriptor discovery

entries.responseKind: GeoServices JSON service, layer, domain, relationship, temporal extent, and estimate payloads.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata reads are addressed by service/layer. Query endpoints use resultOffset/resultRecordCount and native GeoServices filters; those are tested in feature query parity, not this catalog row.
entries.testExpectation: FeatureServer tests cover service/layer metadata, domains, relationships, temporal extent, estimates, auth filtering, and SDK descriptor mapping.

entries.title: GeoServices MapServer metadata
entries.audience: ArcGIS-compatible map clients and SDK render/query adapters.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by service/layer access policy; protected services may require API key or bearer auth.

sdkTargets.dotnet: MapServer metadata client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146

entries.responseKind: GeoServices JSON service, layer, and legend metadata.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata reads are addressed by service/layer. Find/query/export have separate native query semantics.
entries.testExpectation: MapServer tests cover service/layer metadata, legend, WMS/WMTS links, access policy filtering, and SDK metadata read parity.

entries.title: GeoServices ImageServer metadata and raster catalog
entries.audience: ArcGIS-compatible imagery clients and SDK raster metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by raster/service access policy; protected rasters may require API key or bearer auth.

sdkTargets.dotnet: ImageServer metadata client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: ImageServer protocol client metadata and raster catalog methods
sdkTargets.python: client.image_server(...).metadata(), query(), legend(), and statistics helpers

entries.responseKind: GeoServices ImageServer JSON service metadata, raster catalog query results, legend, and statistics/histogram payloads.
entries.paginationFiltering: Raster catalog query supports native GeoServices where/objectIds style filters and result limits where available.
entries.testExpectation: ImageServer tests cover metadata, catalog query filters, legend, statistics/histograms, named and numeric routes, and SDK response parsing.

entries.title: OGC API Features metadata

entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.javascript: OGC Features protocol client metadata methods
sdkTargets.python: OGC Features metadata and collection methods

entries.responseKind: OGC JSON or HTML metadata, OpenAPI JSON, and JSON Schema queryables.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata endpoints are not paged. Feature item endpoints use limit, bbox, datetime, filter, sort, and CRS query semantics outside this metadata row.
entries.testExpectation: OGC Features tests cover landing, conformance, collections, collection detail, queryables, format negotiation, links, and SDK descriptor mapping.

entries.title: OGC API Maps metadata
entries.audience: OGC map clients and SDK render metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: OGC Maps client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: OGC Maps protocol client metadata methods

entries.responseKind: OGC API Maps JSON metadata and tileset metadata; rendered maps are binary outputs outside this metadata row.
entries.paginationFiltering: No metadata paging. Render endpoints use bbox, crs, datetime, collections, style, width/height, and format parameters.
entries.testExpectation: OGC Maps tests cover landing, conformance, OpenAPI, collection map tileset metadata, links, and SDK metadata parsing.

entries.title: OGC API Tiles metadata
entries.audience: OGC tile clients and SDK tile metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: OGC Tiles client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: OGC Tiles protocol client metadata methods

entries.responseKind: OGC API Tiles JSON metadata and tile matrix set JSON.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata lists are not paged. Tile retrieval is addressed by tileMatrixSetId, tileMatrix, tileRow, and tileCol.
entries.testExpectation: OGC Tiles tests cover landing, conformance, collections, dataset/collection tilesets, tile matrix sets, links, and SDK metadata parsing.

entries.title: OGC API Coverages metadata
entries.audience: OGC coverage clients and SDK raster/coverage metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by coverage/raster access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: OGC Coverages client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: OGC Coverages protocol client metadata methods

entries.responseKind: OGC API Coverages JSON metadata, OpenAPI JSON, and coverage schema JSON.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata lists are not paged. Coverage retrieval uses bbox, datetime, crs, subset, scale, and format parameters outside this metadata row.
entries.testExpectation: OGC Coverages tests cover landing, conformance, collections, collection metadata, schema, OpenAPI aliases, links, and SDK parsing.

entries.title: STAC catalog, collections, items, and search
entries.audience: STAC clients and SDK asset catalog/search workflows.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: Concrete STAC client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.python: client.stac().catalog(), collections(), items(), item(), search(), and iterators

entries.responseKind: STAC Catalog, Collection, Item, and ItemCollection JSON.
entries.paginationFiltering: Search supports limit, offset, bbox, datetime, collections, ids, intersects, fields, sortby, filter, filter-lang, and filter-crs. Collection items support collection-scoped item paging/filtering where exposed by the server.
entries.testExpectation: STAC tests cover catalog/collections/items/search, filters, sorting, paging, ETags, access filtering, and SDK iteration semantics.

entries.title: WFS capabilities and feature type schema
entries.audience: WFS clients and SDK XML metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: IHonuaWfsClient capabilities and DescribeFeatureType

entries.responseKind: WFS 2.0/1.1.0/1.0.0 XML capabilities, schema, stored query, feature, or exception reports.
entries.paginationFiltering: Metadata operations are request-parameter based and not paged. GetFeature uses WFS count/startIndex and filter semantics outside this metadata row.
entries.testExpectation: WFS dispatcher tests cover capabilities, DescribeFeatureType, legacy version behavior, XML exceptions, and SDK XML parsing.

entries.title: Classic OGC WMS, WMTS, and WCS capabilities
entries.audience: Classic OGC clients and SDK XML metadata readers.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service/raster access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: WMS/WMTS/WCS client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: WMS and WMTS client capabilities methods
sdkTargets.python: client.wms(...), client.wmts(...), and WCS/coverage capabilities methods

entries.responseKind: WMS, WMTS, or WCS XML capabilities/metadata and binary render/tile/coverage payloads for non-metadata operations.
entries.paginationFiltering: Capabilities are not paged. GetMap/GetFeatureInfo/GetTile/GetCoverage use protocol-specific bbox, layer, style, tile matrix, subset, CRS, time, and format parameters.
entries.testExpectation: Classic OGC tests cover GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, WMS 1.3/1.1.1 axis behavior, WMTS RESTful routes, WCS aliases, and SDK XML/binary response metadata.

entries.title: OData service document and EDM metadata
entries.audience: OData clients, BI tools, and SDK OData metadata/query adapters.
entries.authPosture: Public route filtered by layer/service access policy.

sdkTargets.dotnet: OData client parity target under honua-io/honua-sdk-dotnet#146
sdkTargets.javascript: OData client service document and metadata parser

entries.responseKind: OData JSON service document/layer resources and XML CSDL metadata.
entries.paginationFiltering: OData query endpoints use $filter, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count, $search, and $apply. Metadata endpoints are not paged.
entries.testExpectation: OData tests cover service document, $metadata, layer entity metadata, query options, $batch, and SDK metadata parsing.

entries.title: Unified external source inventory scanner
entries.audience: Operators and SDK migration tooling that inventory external ArcGIS GeoServices REST or GeoServer REST sources.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required. Source auth posture is recorded in the artifact rather than treated as Honua endpoint auth.

sdkTargets.dotnet: HonuaAdminClient.ScanMigrationSourceAsync and migration inventory models

entries.responseKind: honua.migration.source-inventory v1.0 artifact, optionally as indented JSON attachment.
entries.paginationFiltering: Request body uses sourceKind, sourceUrl, timeoutSeconds, credentials where supported, and scanner-specific validation. No response paging.
entries.testExpectation: Migration scanner tests cover sourceKind normalization, ArcGIS/GeoServer inventory artifacts, compatibility codes, failed-artifact behavior, export=json, and SDK model round trips.

entries.title: Legacy external source discovery endpoints
entries.audience: Existing admin workflows that predate the unified migration inventory artifact.
entries.authPosture: Admin authorization required.

sdkTargets.dotnet: Prefer unified ScanMigrationSourceAsync; expose legacy discovery only where needed for compatibility
sdkTargets.javascript: Prefer unified migration scanner; legacy discovery remains optional
sdkTargets.python: Prefer unified migration scanner; legacy discovery remains optional

entries.responseKind: Legacy discovery JSON specific to ArcGIS GeoServices or GeoServer import flows.
entries.paginationFiltering: Request body supplies source URL and timeout/import options. No response paging.
entries.testExpectation: Legacy import endpoint tests remain in place, but new SDK parity should prefer migration-source-inventory unless a compatibility reason is documented.
